content.comment_body: When testing my program online, I want to view current analog input values. The lines between blocks change color to indicate state, but when I expand the table under function blocks, all values show zero. How can I display the actual process values? It's difficult to debug in this situation. Using [product_name] version [version_no] with the latest version of [product_name].

This is a common beginner oversight. The analog block parameter fields only update in simulation mode, not during online testing. If you want to check the current output value while online testing, place the cursor on the block; a glasses icon will appear below it. Click the icon to open an output field (marked with an X), which you can close by clicking X again.

analysis.insight_summary: The user struggles to view real-time analog input values during online tests in [product_name]. Simulation mode updates parameter fields dynamically, whereas online tests do not, causing confusion and hindering debugging. There is a lack of clear differentiation between behaviors in simulation and online testing modes, affecting ease of diagnosing process values.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects analog input values to be displayed and refreshed live in parameter fields under function blocks during online tests, just as they are in simulation mode.
